J Antimicrob Chemother 1988; 22: 951–2. Pharmacokinetics Metronidazole is readily and almost completely ab- sorbed after oral doses. Peak plasma concentrations of about 6 and 12 micrograms/mL are achieved, usually within 1 to 2 hours, after single doses of 250 and 500 mg respectively. Some accumulation occurs and consequently there are higher concentrations when multiple doses are given. Absorption may be delayed, but is not reduced overall by food.
